widgets.title: Clock
widgets.description: The classic clock — time and date, nothing else.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: Compass
widgets.description: A simple magnetic compass. Combines the magnetometer and accelerometer for a steady bearing. Works offline.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: Live GPS Map
widgets.description: A small map that follows your GPS in real time. Pulsing dot shows where you are; the map pans with you as you move.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: Morse Flashlight
widgets.description: Type a message; the torch blinks it in Morse code — long flash for a dash, short for a dot.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: QR & Barcode Scanner
widgets.description: Scans both QR codes and 1D barcodes through the camera. Copies the result to the clipboard, or opens it directly if it's a URL or phone number.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: Water Tracker
widgets.description: Tap a glass to mark it drunk. Tracks your daily intake, resets at midnight, and nudges you with a reminder if you've gone too long without a sip.
widgets.author: iappyx

widgets.title: Weather
widgets.description: Current conditions for your GPS location. Pulls from the free Open-Meteo API — no key needed.
widgets.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Bouncing balls
wallpapers.description: Twenty colourful balls bounce around your home screen, dodging your icons and widgets in real time. Rearrange your layout and the balls find a new path.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Cells flow
wallpapers.description: An animated mosaic of warm orange and cool blue cells, pulsing and shifting organically.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Chromatic Halo Bloom
wallpapers.description: Each icon and widget gets a glowing halo around its edges, all cycling through the colour spectrum on a 12-second loop.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Clouds
wallpapers.description: Drifting 3D clouds with a warm sun. Painterly, calm.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Digital Rain
wallpapers.description: Matrix-style green katakana raining down with a soft glow. Capped at 30fps to stay battery-friendly.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Falling Snow
wallpapers.description: Snowflakes drift downward and pile up at the bottom of the screen. Shake the device to clear the pile with a flash.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Fireworks
wallpapers.description: Looped fireworks against a black sky.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Hue drift
wallpapers.description: A slow-drifting radial colour gradient. Subtle parallax on home-screen swipes, plus a tilt response from the device sensors.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Live map
wallpapers.description: An interactive map centred on your real-time GPS location. The map pans with you as you move.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Live Weather Scenes
wallpapers.description: Real-time weather scenes that change with the conditions outside: sun, clouds, rain, thunderstorm, snow, or fog. Refreshes every ten minutes.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Magnetic Neon Particles
wallpapers.description: Hundreds of glowing particles that respond to your phone's motion. Tilt to fling them, shake for a burst, hold still and they cluster around invisible magnets.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Material Color Drift
wallpapers.description: An infinite grid of Material Design colour swatches drifting smoothly in every direction. 190 colours tiled seamlessly.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Neon Halo Drift
wallpapers.description: A 3D halo of neon particles slowly orbiting through space against a deep dark background.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Neon Web Drift
wallpapers.description: Glowing nodes connected by lines, drifting through 3D space. Subtle ripple on touch.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Rotating Radial Gradient
wallpapers.description: A radial rainbow gradient that slowly rotates.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Shake for a Photo
wallpapers.description: Shake your phone to fetch a new random landscape photo. Smooth crossfade between shots.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

wallpapers.title: Waves
wallpapers.description: A calm 3D ocean-wave mesh in deep navy.
wallpapers.author: iappyx

transitions.title: 3D cube
transitions.description: Six home screens form a 3D cube; pages turn around the meeting edge as you swipe.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Aperture
transitions.description: Pages contract to a dot in the centre, then bloom back out into the next page.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Card stack
transitions.description: The outgoing page lifts and tilts back like a dealer flicking a card off the top of a deck.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Carousel
transitions.description: Pages rotate around their own centres like records on a turntable.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Column rain
transitions.description: Columns drop off the bottom one at a time, left to right; new columns drop in from the top in the same order.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Depth stack
transitions.description: The outgoing page recedes (fades and scales down) as the incoming one slides over it.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Dissolve
transitions.description: Cells fade out individually in a stochastic speckle, like an old film cut.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Explode
transitions.description: Cells radiate outward from the centre with a spin, then settle into the new page.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Fade
transitions.description: A pure crossfade — no motion at all.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Frosted blur
transitions.description: The outgoing page blurs out as the incoming one sharpens into focus. Android 12+.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Horizontal sweep
transitions.description: The default left/right slide between pages.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Implode & explode
transitions.description: Cells collapse to the screen centre, then burst back out into their new positions on the incoming page.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Scatter
transitions.description: Each cell flies to its own off-screen point instead of moving as a slab.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Tilt cascade
transitions.description: The horizontal slide with a 3D tilt; the page reads as a flipping card.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Vertical fall
transitions.description: Pages fall up or down between cards instead of sliding sideways.
transitions.author: iappyx

transitions.title: Zoom-through
transitions.description: Pages zoom out as new ones zoom in. Quick and punchy.
transitions.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Aurora
iconFilters.description: Holographic cyan→magenta→gold→teal sheen over each icon
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Mono accent
iconFilters.description: Greyscale icons tinted to your system accent (Material You)
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Pixelate
iconFilters.description: 8-bit retro: icons downsampled to chunky pixels
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Rainbow matrix
iconFilters.description: Greyscale, tinted by grid position — radial rainbow
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Sepia
iconFilters.description: Warm brown vintage tones, like an old photo print
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Tinted mono
iconFilters.description: Each icon recoloured with its own dominant colour
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Vintage
iconFilters.description: Faded saturation with a warm shift — old polaroid feel
iconFilters.author: iappyx

iconFilters.title: Wallpaper themed
iconFilters.description: Tints sampled from your wallpaper, distributed across the grid
iconFilters.author: iappyx
